contracts.name: check_ai_governance
contracts.purpose: Validate canonical AI governance documents, traceability metadata, runtime leak boundaries, and governance follow-up warnings.

contracts.name: check_code_shape
contracts.purpose: Check repo Python and shell files against code-shape budgets for staged or repo-wide review.

contracts.name: ruff_python_linter
contracts.purpose: Run the repo P0 Python linter over harness hooks, scripts, and tests.
contracts.notes: Ruff is intentionally scoped to E9 and Pyflakes F rules first.

contracts.name: git_diff_whitespace_check
contracts.purpose: Detect whitespace errors in the current changed diff before CI or review.

contracts.name: check_requirements_shape
contracts.purpose: Validate REQDOC, REQ, WS, traceability matrix, and external source-boundary metadata shape.

contracts.name: check_context_budget
contracts.purpose: Warn when always-on context, active handoffs, ADR count, skills, or server declarations approach configured budgets.

contracts.name: check_branch_hygiene
contracts.purpose: Audit GitHub branch hygiene, open PR budgets, stale branches, and failed open PRs.
contracts.notes: Default strict audit is read-only; dangerous flags need separate human confirmation.

contracts.name: check_github_guardrails
contracts.purpose: Audit local and remote GitHub guardrails including workflows, CODEOWNERS, PR template, permissions, Dependabot, and branch protection visibility.
contracts.notes: Remote UNKNOWN and plan-limited findings are evidence, not success.

contracts.name: reduce_runtime_observations
contracts.purpose: Reduce local runtime observation JSONL into a handoff-first markdown draft for main-agent review.
outputs: markdown draft on stdout or output file

contracts.name: stop_runtime_observation
contracts.purpose: Append sanitized Stop hook observations and local agent-trace/v1 events for runtime recovery.
inputs: Codex Stop hook JSON payload on stdin
contracts.notes: Writes local runtime evidence only; it does not export to OpenTelemetry, OpenAI, or any remote trace backend.

contracts.name: stop_runtime_session
contracts.purpose: Persist the local runtime session markdown and execution snapshot used for bounded checkpoint and resume.
inputs: Codex Stop hook JSON payload on stdin
contracts.notes: Writes local resume artifacts only. The execution snapshot supports bounded checkpoint and resume but does not promote runtime files to canonical governance truth.

contracts.name: check_agent_trace_schema
contracts.purpose: Validate the repo-local agent trace JSON Schema and JSONL sample.

contracts.name: check_agent_eval_dataset
contracts.purpose: Validate the standard agent workflow eval dataset shape and referenced repo checks.

contracts.name: run_agent_eval_dataset
contracts.purpose: Run or dry-run the standard agent workflow eval dataset with a deterministic local grader.
contracts.notes: The default contract command is dry-run. Running without --dry-run executes each selected eval item's expected repo-local checks and should be an explicit local action.

contracts.name: check_task_outcome_eval_dataset
contracts.purpose: Validate the task outcome eval dataset that measures real task completion quality beside workflow-only evals.

contracts.name: run_task_outcome_eval_dataset
contracts.purpose: Dry-run or execute the task outcome eval dataset with outcome, overreach, resume-stability, and cost proxies.
contracts.notes: The default contract command is dry-run. Executing without --dry-run runs repo-local checks only and reports task outcome, aggregate pass/warn/review/fail counts, blocked resume/guardrail counts, and bounded cost proxies.

contracts.name: export_agent_trace_local
contracts.purpose: Convert agent-trace/v1 JSONL into a local JSON adapter payload without remote network export.
contracts.notes: This adapter sets network_exported=false and does not claim OpenAI, OTLP, MCP, or A2A interoperability.

contracts.name: export_agent_trace_otlp_pilot
contracts.purpose: Render agent-trace/v1 JSONL as OTLP HTTP JSON for local interop pilots; network export requires explicit --send and --endpoint.
inputs: explicit endpoint only when --send is used
outputs: optional HTTP status when --send is explicit
contracts.auth_scope: explicit endpoint only when --send is used
contracts.sandbox_requirement: explicit operator send decision for network path
contracts.notes: Default command is no-network. Using --send performs an OTLP HTTP POST and must be treated as explicit manual interop evidence, not OpenAI/MCP/A2A completion.

contracts.name: verify_remote_trace_interop
contracts.purpose: Run one bounded OTLP probe and emit an interop report that distinguishes local-only, pilot-remote, and verified-remote claim levels.
inputs: explicit endpoint only when --send is used
contracts.auth_scope: bounded single probe with explicit endpoint and optional verified-remote review
contracts.sandbox_requirement: explicit operator send decision for network path
contracts.notes: The default command is local-only and no-network. A verified-remote claim requires a successful bounded probe plus explicit operator review evidence; the script does not auto-upgrade pilot-remote to broad interop completion, loopback / localhost endpoints cannot be promoted to verified-remote, and raw request/response payloads are withheld.

contracts.name: check_remote_trace_interop_report
contracts.purpose: Validate bounded remote trace interop reports and prevent local capture-server evidence from being misreported as verified remote interoperability.
contracts.auth_scope: no auth by default; report validation only
contracts.notes: The validator rejects verified-remote reports backed only by localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, or other loopback endpoint evidence.

contracts.name: summarize_runtime_traces
contracts.purpose: Summarize local runtime observations and agent-trace/v1 JSONL into a bounded no-network report for promotion review.
contracts.notes: This report is local evidence only. It does not upload traces, claim OpenAI/OTLP/MCP/A2A interoperability, or replace canonical docs.

contracts.name: check_runtime_execution_snapshots
contracts.purpose: Validate local execution snapshot artifacts used for bounded checkpoint and resume.

contracts.name: summarize_harness_capabilities
contracts.purpose: Summarize durability, interop, task-eval, and high-impact guardrail coverage into a compact control-plane view.
contracts.notes: This summary compresses existing evidence surfaces including resume readiness, local/pilot/verified interop counts, endpoint failure mode, task-eval aggregate counts, and blocked resume/guardrail reasons; it does not create new evidence or upgrade advisory controls by itself.

contracts.name: collect_harness_sample_gaps
contracts.purpose: List pending real-scenario sample gaps for security evidence, AI guardrails, workflow skills, and future trace interop, with current sample-checker and generic gap-ledger counts where available.
inputs: static sample gap registry in script
contracts.notes: The collector targets missing real samples and reports current sample counts, including the generic gap evidence ledger. CI writes markdown plus JSON collector output and appends the markdown report to the GitHub step summary. It does not create evidence by itself.

contracts.name: check_harness_sample_gap_evidence
contracts.purpose: Validate the generic bounded JSONL intake for roadmap sample gaps that do not yet have a dedicated checker, including bounded local and remote interop samples.
contracts.notes: Local interop evidence proves only local harness behavior. Remote interop evidence must use source_type real-interop-run, keep no_external_claim=true, set local_only=false, record only bounded endpoint_scope/remote_status/network_exported fields, and avoid raw payloads, prompts, transcripts, secrets, account ids, runtime paths, or tool output. evidence_refs must resolve to existing repo-relative paths; path selectors such as markdown anchors, pytest node ids, or JSONL line suffixes are allowed only when the underlying repo path exists. A pending or accepted real-interop-run sample opens review only; it does not prove hosted collector, OpenAI, MCP, A2A, or native sandbox interoperability.

contracts.name: check_harness_burn_in_readiness
contracts.purpose: Summarize whether roadmap sample gaps have enough accepted real, cross-task, or task-class evidence to discuss check upgrades, including ready-gap upgrade decision visibility.
inputs: static sample gap registry in script
outputs: per-gap upgrade decision status and decision ref

ready next evidence needed by gap
active area, priority, gap-id, capture-gate, and readiness filters
per-gap target artifact and target checker command
per-gap ledger action, lane-specific focused planner command, lane-specific focused intake command, and lane review command

contracts.notes: This readiness audit does not collect samples, generate evidence, or upgrade check levels. Local Trace Summary readiness counts accepted distinct task classes, not raw report rows. The --area and --priority filters narrow the audit by roadmap bucket, --gap-id narrows it to one or more exact gaps, --capture-gate narrows it to one or more real-event preconditions, and --readiness narrows it to one or more readiness states such as needs-first-real-sample, needs-more-real-samples, ready-for-upgrade-discussion, or local-sample-only; empty filtered scopes stay read-only and report zero matching readiness items instead of implying evidence. Each readiness item exposes its target artifact, target checker command, ledger action, lane-specific focused planner command, lane-specific focused intake command, and lane review command so operators can move from readiness status to the correct no-write append, replacement, upgrade-decision, contract-precondition, or no-sample path without opening pending focus first or running a generic intake command that returns an empty lane. Ready-for-upgrade discussion rows expose the current upgrade decision status, decision ref, aggregate decision counts, any missing decision ids, per-item next_evidence_needed, and top-level ready_next_evidence_needed_by_gap so keep-advisory follow-up evidence from the upgrade decision ledger is visible in readiness output without opening the upgrade-decision audit first. contracts.name: check_harness_placeholder_replacement

A candidate must match an existing pending placeholder sample id, still belong to the current fill-existing-placeholder lane, keep outcome=pending, pass the target sample checker, and become review-ready before an operator replaces the placeholder row. contracts.notes: This is an advisory inventory only. It separates accepted real samples from synthetic, local-replay, and local-only accepted records, marks pending rows as review-ready or placeholder, groups queued and actionable gaps by ledger action, and separates actionable sample gaps from future-work contract blockers, ready upgrade-decision gaps, and local-only evidence so queued-without-pending is not treated as a single collection state. Pending review blockers include no_external_claim drift, real/local local_only mismatches, red-team pending boundary drift, local trace no_network/local_only drift, and Stage Checkpoint cross-task resume template checkpoint drift so ambiguous pending rows remain placeholders instead of becoming outcome-review targets. Contract-blocked rows also expose contract_blocker_states from the future-work contract checker, including missing ADR refs, sample collection boundary, next action, and review command, so pending output stays machine-routable without approving sampling. Approved future-work gaps are counted as actionable sample gaps rather than contract blockers. Local-only accepted gaps stay under no-sample-collection and do not produce next collection lane commands. Ready-for-upgrade discussion gaps stay under review-upgrade-decision and route to decision review instead of append-new-pending-slot. Pending output also exposes ready_upgrade_decision_next_evidence_by_gap from the current collection queue so keep-advisory follow-up evidence for ready gaps is visible beside the pending accounting and lane command summary. It also reports actionable gaps without review-ready pending so placeholder rows remain visible as real-event capture targets, then emits next collection lane commands for placeholder fills, new pending rows, review-ready pending outcome review, ready-gap upgrade-decision review, and future-work contract preconditions when those lanes are in scope. It also emits a bounded next_capture_focus list for actionable gaps without review-ready pending so operators can start with lane-specific focused planner/intake/review commands carrying each entry's current ledger_action, capture_gate/capture_gate_detail preconditions, and an evidence_needed checklist instead of scanning the full queue, hand-writing a generic --gap-id scope, or opening the intake bundle first. Placeholder replacement focus entries also include pending_slot_refs and pending_review_blockers so the existing row to replace and its current blockers are visible without opening review cards. Focus entries with ledger accepted-real/readiness mismatches also include readiness_metric_delta so a standalone focus card cannot hide that accepted real ledger rows differ from the exact readiness source metric. JSON also includes next_capture_focus_area_filter, next_capture_focus_priority_filter, next_capture_focus_ledger_action_filter, next_capture_focus_capture_gate_filter, next_capture_focus_readiness_filter, next_capture_focus_count, next_capture_focus_available_count, next_capture_focus_limit, next_capture_focus_truncated, next_capture_focus_hidden_gap_ids, next_capture_focus_shown_area_counts, next_capture_focus_available_area_counts, next_capture_focus_shown_priority_counts, next_capture_focus_available_priority_counts, next_capture_focus_shown_ledger_action_counts, next_capture_focus_available_ledger_action_counts, next_capture_focus_shown_capture_gate_counts, next_capture_focus_available_capture_gate_counts, next_capture_focus_shown_readiness_counts, and next_capture_focus_available_readiness_counts so consumers can distinguish capped output from complete output, see active capture-focus filters, and see the exact gap ids plus area, priority, ledger-action, capture-gate, or readiness buckets hidden behind the cap; each next_capture_focus entry includes area, capture_gate, capture_gate_detail, readiness, readiness_metric_delta, evidence_needed, pending_slot_refs, and pending_review_blockers so JSON consumers get the roadmap area, real-event precondition, readiness state, accepted-real/readiness mismatch if present, bounded evidence checklist, and placeholder row refs and blockers for replacement lanes. The default capture focus limit is 5 entries; --capture-focus-limit 0 expands all matching actionable capture lanes while remaining read-only. The --capture-focus-area, --capture-focus-priority, --capture-focus-ledger-action, --capture-focus-gate, and --capture-focus-readiness filters narrow only the next_capture_focus selection/card rendering, not the broader pending accounting or queue totals. The --capture-focus mode prints compact read-only focus cards with roadmap area, target artifact, target checker, planner, intake, lane review, capture gate, readiness metric delta when present, evidence needed checklist, pending refs, pending blockers, trigger, boundary fields, shown/available focus count, area / priority / ledger-action / capture-gate / readiness bucket counts, focus limit, truncation status, hidden gap ids, and active area / priority / ledger-action / capture-gate / readiness filters; empty focus scopes print an explicit no-match message. The fill-existing-placeholder lane and placeholder review cards route operators to check_harness_placeholder_replacement.py <candidate-jsonl> before replacing a row. The append-new-pending-slot lane routes operators to check_harness_sample_append.py <candidate-jsonl> before appending a new pending row. The review-upgrade-decision lane routes operators through focused planner/intake output, check_harness_upgrade_decision_candidate.py <candidate-jsonl>, and check_harness_upgrade_decisions.py before accepting keep/promote/defer decisions. Review-ready pending lanes and cards route operators to check_harness_sample_outcome.py <candidate-jsonl> before changing outcome to accepted or rejected. Review cards can be focused by gap id or review state and bind pending slots to checker commands, evidence class, review state, review blockers, ledger_action, capture_gate/capture_gate_detail, trigger, evidence_needed checklist, replacement review commands, outcome review commands, and readiness so placeholder card output includes the real-event precondition without opening capture focus. CI uses the future/local-inclusive markdown plus JSON report, default, full-expansion, active-area capture focus, active-priority capture focus, append-new-pending-slot capture focus, fill-existing-placeholder capture focus, remote-interop capture focus, approved-bounded-incident capture focus, placeholder-replacement capture focus, security-workflow-event capture focus, bounded-real-incident capture focus, workflow-task-event capture focus, cross-task-resume capture focus, distinct-task-class-report capture focus, user-confirmed-high-impact-action capture focus, needs-first-real-sample, and needs-more-real-samples capture focus cards, and placeholder review cards for the GitHub step summary without changing ledgers. Empty filtered text output and empty filtered card sets print explicit no-match messages, but the script does not collect samples, accept pending slots, append evidence, approve future-work sampling, or upgrade any check.
